requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 每 2 秒向串口监视器输出一次 Hello Arduino。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Drive io_0 delta inputs that sum to 2000ms (first interval) then to another 2000ms (second interval), with intermediate control steps using smaller positive deltas; keep all deltas valid so the accumulated elapsed crosses 2000ms exactly at the intended steps.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger and io_1 and serial_0_value_0 are true exactly on the control steps where the accumulated elapsed reaches/exceeds 2000ms, producing one Hello Arduino fixed-text report per 2-second period; between these trigger steps the outputs are false.
